name: Media Production
description: Create and edit images, videos, audio and documents, and deliver them as downloadable conversation artifacts.
progressive_guidance: For local charts use echarts.render with native ECharts JSON options; return separate SVG/PNG artifacts or embed them in documents. For local PDFs and document page images use typst; for local editable Word files use document.create. Hosted generation uses the existing image, video, audio and document tools with profile defaults.
